Subject: Quick follow-up about today's walkthrough

Hi Liam,

I noticed you weren't able to make the walkthrough scheduled for today — completely understand, these things happen. I just wanted to check in and offer two quick paths so we can keep momentum:

1) Async option: I can record a 10–15 minute walkthrough tailored to what you signed up for, include a short checklist for your engineers, and share it here.
2) Live 20-minute slot: happy to rebook — I have a couple of openings I can hold while we confirm.

If you prefer sync, the two windows I'm holding are:
- Tue 2/22, 10:30–10:50 EST
- Wed 2/23, 15:00–15:20 EST

If neither works, tell me a couple of windows that do and I'll coordinate. Also looping Diego so he can suggest a short technical agenda if you want the developer POV on the call.

Best,

SDR, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0142

Hi Priyom — thanks for the follow-up and sorry about the no-show. My CTO got pulled into an urgent ops issue midday and we couldn't make it. We still want to see Redwood in action, but a couple notes:
- We're low on time this week — live only works if it's tightly scoped to our SSO + data retention questions.
- Otherwise an async demo plus a short Q&A (15–20m) next week would be great.

Can you do the async walkthrough first? If it looks good we'll book a short follow-up with the CTO and one engineer.

Thanks,

Liam O'Connor
Product Lead, StreamlineOps
liam@streamlineops.com

Date: 2027-02-22T14:30:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up about today's walkthrough

Thanks for the context, Liam — totally understood.

We can do the async-first approach and follow with a focused 15–20 minute live Q&A for SSO and retention questions. Attached is a very short mini-agenda I usually share for the async path (two slides worth):
- 0–5m: Quick product highlights tied to common infra questions
- 5–12m: Demo of inference at scale + telemetry/observability overview
- 12–15m: How we handle SSO, key management, and retention controls

If that looks good I will: 1) share the recorded walkthrough by EOD tomorrow, and 2) hold three tentative 20-minute Q&A windows next week (you can confirm one):
- Tue 2/28, 11:00–11:20 EST (hold)
- Wed 3/01, 09:30–09:50 EST (hold)
- Wed 3/01, 16:00–16:20 EST (hold)

Also attaching the mini-agenda here for easy review. If you want any specific logs/telemetry examples included in the recording, tell me what we should surface and I'll add it.

Best,

diego@redwood.ai
